name: Machine Chest Press
summary: A machine-guided horizontal pressing exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, anterior deltoids, and triceps.

setup: Adjust the seat height so that the handles align with the mid-to-lower portion of your chest.
Sit back firmly against the back pad with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your wrists neutral and aligned with your forearms.
steps: Retract your shoulder blades against the pad and brace your core.
Press the handles smoothly forward by extending your arms and contracting your chest until your elbows are extended without locking out.
Pause briefly at full extension while maintaining tension on the pectorals.
Control the handles backward under continuous tension until you feel a comfortable stretch across your chest, reversing before the weight stack touches down.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you press the handles forward; inhale smoothly as you lower the weight back toward your chest.
cues: Keep shoulders pinned to the pad

common_faults.fault: Seat set too low or too high
common_faults.correction: Position the seat so the handles align directly with the nipple line, keeping the shoulders in a safe pressing angle.

common_faults.fault: Protracted, rolling shoulders off the pad
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper back and shoulder blades firmly pinned against the backrest throughout the entire repetition.

common_faults.fault: Allowing the weight plates to slam at the bottom
common_faults.correction: Maintain muscular tension and stop just before the weight stack rests on the bottom.

precautions: Set the seat and range-of-motion limiter so your shoulders are not forced into excessive hyperextension at the start.
